evals.name: build-standalone-no-tautologies
evals.prompt:
Use pr-graph:build standalone to implement ticket ACME-104 in the fixture repo.

Environment for this eval run (the real integrations are unavailable):
- Do not start a pr-graph run and do not call any pr-graph coordinator, event, or artifact script. spec_audit.rb is allowed.
- Linear is unavailable. The ticket is the JSON file under .ticket/ in the fixture repo. Do not call any Linear tool. Write the test plan from it.
- Worktree: the fixture repo at <fixture-dir>. It is a throwaway checkout, so create the branch acme-104-vendor-status from main in place. Never modify the main branch.
- Base: the commit the tag `base` points at.
- Tests: bin/test runs the whole suite. There is no linter; say so and continue.
- Subagents may be spawned as the skill directs. Scratch worktrees for mutations go under <out-dir>/scratch. Nothing outside <fixture-dir> and <out-dir> may be written.
When done, write the build report to <out-dir>/build_report.json.
evals.expected_output: Branch acme-104-vendor-status with reviewed commits and passing bin/test, specs written red-first for Vendor status defaults, exact with_status filtering, and rejection of unknown statuses, none that restate the STATUSES constant, and a build report whose spec_audit spec_audit.rb accepts.
assertions: The committed acme-104-vendor-status candidate passes bin/test and the status contract, with a committed test
The committed tests contain no specs that restate Acme::Vendor::STATUSES (size, frozen, literal members)
The committed suite fails under each with_status mutant (returns-all, returns-none, no-validation)
build_report.json records a well-formed red spec_first run citing every changed test file
build_report.json carries a spec_audit of the final candidate against the base that spec_audit.rb check accepts
The transcript spawns the pg-BUILD writer and the pg-BUILD-review, pg-BUILD-simplify, and pg-VERIFY-specs lanes
Every lane spawn pins its model: pg-BUILD and pg-BUILD-simplify on sonnet, pg-BUILD-review and pg-VERIFY-specs on opus
No pr-graph run was started (no execution, artifact, or failure stream)
The main branch still points at the base tag
